notes:
Changelog: native dnd5e mode (without Midi-QoL)

Every feature below runs only when Midi-QoL is not active, and each has its own world setting that is off by default. In the module settings they're under the Automation heading.

v2.3.0

Saving Throw Rules

  • Automatic failures: Strength and Dexterity saves fail automatically while a creature is Paralyzed, Stunned, Unconscious or Petrified. With Automated Conditions 5e (AC5E) automating statuses, AC5E enforces the failure and the card still explains it. No Luck Dice prompt is offered on an automatic failure.
  • Advantage from traits:
    • Magic Resistance (spells and magic items).
    • Gnome Cunning.
    • Duergar Resilience and Dwarven Resilience.
    • Fey Ancestry (charmed) and Brave (frightened), including saves to end those conditions.
    • 2014 Danger Sense.
  • Aura of Protection: allies within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th level) add the paladin's Charisma modifier, minimum +1.
  • Evasion: no damage on a successful Dexterity save, half on a failure (requires Save Automation on Full).
  • Where the reasons show: in the roll window and on the save card. A save folded into its spell's card shows its reason there.

Bardic Inspiration, Guidance, Lucky & Indomitable

These are offered beside the Luck Dice after a failed attack, check or save, including to creatures without Luck Dice.

  • Bardic Inspiration: the bard's target is marked automatically. The die is added, then used up.
  • 2014 Guidance and Resistance: +1d4 to a check or a save, then the spell ends.

Full details in the release notes.
